mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that may prompt central bank intervention and reduce corporate hiring costs, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 months), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust demand growth, which signals strong corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 102.0), supply chain bottlenecks ease and manufacturing output expands, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%), or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic strength, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of very low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.25%), the central bank's accommodative stance supports risk-taking and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
